The soldiers of the Caucasian mountains are adapted to its harsh terrain. The Armenians and Georgians of the Caucasus are well adapted to travelling to and fro with a light step. Knowledgable in all the nooks and crannies of the Caucasus. Because of this, the soldiers mainly serve as lightly armoured skirmishers armed with swords, javelins, slings, and bows.
